title: NEM PowerCoder Training Example
description: One solver-verified, provenance-complete training example for the NEM PowerCoder mission (MISSION.md M04). Every numeric value in 'expected' must come from a real solver execution recorded in 'execution'. The lifecycle status tracks the M04 dataset lifecycle: proposed -> generated -> executed -> verified -> accepted/rejected -> versioned -> train/validation/test.

example_id.description: Deterministic content-addressed ID: 'ex_' + first 16 hex chars of sha256 over the canonical task definition (family, subfamily, topology, seed, task.inputs). Identical inputs -> identical ID.

subfamily.description: Concrete task template within the family.

topology.description: Network topology identifier (case ID). Used to partition splits and prevent leakage between topologically-related examples.

seed.description: Deterministic per-example seed. Together with (family, subfamily, topology) it fully determines the task parameters.

prompt.description: The user-facing task (conversational SFT user turn).

inputs.description: The deterministic, seed-derived task parameters (case, element, target, metrics, ...). Canonical serialization of this object (with family/subfamily/topology/seed) is the example_id hash input.

answer.description: The expected assistant response (conversational SFT assistant turn). For fit tasks, states the fitted scalar; for report/trajectory tasks, states the solver measurements.

structured.description: Machine-checkable expected values (the fitted scalar, reported metrics, trajectory tool results). Every number here is a real solver output.

validity.description: Physical validity of the expected operating point (MISSION.md invariant: convergence != physical validity).

input_hash.description: sha256 of the case file bytes (or deterministic fixture descriptor).

result_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical (sorted-keys) JSON of the solver-derived payload. Identical solver output on the same pinned stack hashes identically.

seed.description: The base seed used for the generation run (distinct from the per-example 'seed' field, which is derived from it).

git_commit.description: Full 40-char git SHA of the repo at generation time.

licence.description: Licence of the underlying data + generated example.

source_refs.description: Provenance references: case file, element list artifact, discovery script, MISSION.md work package.

split.description: Assigned by split.py. 'benchmark' examples are reserved and excluded from train/validation/test.

rejection_reason.description: Set when status is rejected/quarantined (e.g. fit did not converge to tolerance -> retained for repair training).
